questions.question: The area of a trapezium shaped field is 1720 m², the distance between its parallel sides is 40 m and the length of one of the parallel sides is 48 m. What is the length (in m) of the other parallel side?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Sum of parallel sides = (2 × Area) ÷ Height

⇒ 48 + b = (2 × 1720) ÷ 40

⇒ 48 + b = 3440 ÷ 40 = 86

⇒ b = 86 − 48 = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of trapezium = 1720 m²

Distance between parallel sides (h) = 40 m

Length of one parallel side (a) = 48 m

Let the other parallel side be b.

 

 
• 
 

 b = ?
 a = 48 m
 h = 40 m
 Area = 1720 m²

**Formula Used:**

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × (Sum of parallel sides) × Height

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1720 = 1/2 × (48 + b) × 40

⇒ 1720 = 20 × (48 + b)

⇒ 48 + b = 1720 ÷ 20

⇒ 48 + b = 86

⇒ b = 86 − 48

⇒ b = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Area of a Trapezium

The area is half the product of the sum of parallel sides and the perpendicular distance between them. Formula: A = 1/2 × (a + b) × h

Perimeter of a Trapezium

The sum of all four sides of the trapezium. Perimeter = a + b + c + d, where a and b are the parallel sides, and c and d are the non-parallel sides.

Isosceles Trapezium

A trapezium in which the non-parallel sides are equal in length. The base angles are equal, and its diagonals are also equal in length.

Median of a Trapezium

The line segment connecting the midpoints of the non-parallel sides. Length of median = 1/2 × (a + b).

questions.question: Ram can do a piece of work in 18 hours. Shyam and Naresh can do it in 9 hours. Ram and Naresh can do it in 12 hours. How long will Shyam alone take to do it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ram can do a piece of work in 18 hours.

Shyam and Naresh together can do it in 9 hours.

Ram and Naresh together can do it in 12 hours.

**Formula Used:**

If A can do a piece of work in x hours and B can do the same work in y hours, then together they can do it in (1)/(frac{1){x}+(1)/(y)} hours.

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be the LCM of 18, 9, and 12, which is 36 units.

Efficiency of Ram = (36)/(18) = 2 units/hour

Efficiency of Shyam and Naresh together = (36)/(9) = 4 units/hour

Efficiency of Ram and Naresh together = (36)/(12) = 3 units/hour

Let the efficiency of Naresh be N units/hour.

Then, the efficiency of Shyam = (4 - N) units/hour.

Since Ram and Naresh together do 3 units/hour and Ram's efficiency is 2 units/hour,

⇒ N = 3 - 2 = 1 unit/hour

So, the efficiency of Shyam = 4 - 1 = 3 units/hour.

Time taken by Shyam alone to do the work = (Total\:Work)/(Efficiency\:of\:Shyam) = (36)/(3) = 12 hours

**Shyam alone will take 12 hours to do the work.**

questions.question: If (x - 2) is a factor of (2x2 + 12kx - 25k), then what is the value of k?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(x - 2) is a factor of 2x² + 12kx - 25k.

**Formula Used:**

If (x - a) is a factor of a polynomial, then the polynomial will equal zero when x = a.

**Calculation:**

Let's substitute x = 2 in the polynomial 2x² + 12kx - 25k.

⇒ 2(2)² + 12k(2) - 25k = 0

⇒ 8 + 24k - 25k = 0

⇒ 8 - k = 0

⇒ k = 8

**Therefore, the value of k is 8.**

questions.question: A 360 m long train running at the speed of 108 km/h crosses another train running in the opposite direction at the speed of 90 km/h in 12 seconds. What is the length (in m) of the other train?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative Speed in opposite direction = 108 + 90 = 198 km/h.

Speed in m/s = 198 × (5/18) = 55 m/s.

Total distance covered in 12 seconds = 55 × 12 = 660 m.

Length of the other train = Total distance − Length of first train.

Length = 660 − 360 = 300 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 300 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of train 1 (L₁) = 360 m

Speed of train 1 (S₁) = 108 km/h

Speed of train 2 (S₂) = 90 km/h

Time taken to cross (T) = 12 s

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = S₁ + S₂

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/h × (5/18)

Distance = Speed × Time

questions.question: A cuboid with dimension 2 × 4 × 1 units is melted and a new cube is made. What is the total surface area of the cube formed in square units?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of the cuboid = 2 × 4 × 1 units.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cuboid = length × breadth × height

Volume of cube = side³

Surface area of cube = 6 × side²

**Calculation:**

Volume of the cuboid = 2 × 4 × 1 = 8 cubic units

Let the side of the cube formed be 'a' units.

⇒ Volume of cube = a³ = 8 cubic units

⇒ a = 2 units

Surface area of the cube = 6 × a²

⇒ Surface area = 6 × 2²

⇒ Surface area = 6 × 4

⇒ Surface area = 24 square units

**The total surface area of the cube formed is 24 square units.**

questions.question: Samridhi sold a gold ring at a loss of 26%. If the cost price of the gold ring is ₹38,500, what is the selling price of the gold ring?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of the gold ring = ₹38,500.

Loss% = 26%.

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Cost Price - (Loss% of Cost Price)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Loss = 26% of ₹38,500

⇒ Loss = (26/100) × ₹38,500

⇒ Loss = ₹10,010

⇒ Selling Price = ₹38,500 - ₹10,010

⇒ Selling Price = ₹28,490

**The selling price of the gold ring is ₹28,490.**

questions.question: P and Q are inversely proportional to each other and P is 10, when Q is 6. What will be the value of Q when P is 15?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For inverse proportion: P₁ × Q₁ = P₂ × Q₂

Product must remain constant: 10 × 6 = 60

Now, 15 × Q = 60

Q = 60 ÷ 15 = 4

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial P (P₁) = 10

Initial Q (Q₁) = 6

New P (P₂) = 15

**Formula Used:**

In inverse proportion, P ∝ 1/Q ⇒ P × Q = k (Constant)

 
 Case 1
 P = 10
 Q = 6
 
 →
 
 
 Case 2
 P = 15
 Q = ?
 
 Product (P × Q) remains Constant = 60

**Calculations:**

⇒ P₁ × Q₁ = k

⇒ 10 × 6 = 60

⇒ Now, P₂ × Q₂ = 60

⇒ 15 × Q₂ = 60

⇒ Q₂ = 60 ÷ 15

⇒ Q₂ = 4

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportion

Two quantities are in direct proportion if an increase in one leads to a proportional increase in the other (y/x = k or y₁/x₁ = y₂/x₂).

Inverse Proportion

Two quantities are in inverse proportion if an increase in one leads to a proportional decrease in the other (xy = k or x₁y₁ = x₂y₂).

Proportionality Constant

The value k is known as the constant of proportionality, which relates the two variables in any state of the relationship.</p

questions.question: Shobha purchased a small plot in a residential area for Rs. 6,00,000 and sold it to Lakshita at a profit of 20%. Lakshita, in turn, sold it to Dinesh at a loss of 10%. How much did Dinesh pay for the plot?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of the plot for Shobha = Rs. 6,00,000.

Profit made by Shobha = 20%.

Loss made by Lakshita = 10%.

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Profit%)

Cost Price (CP) after loss = Selling Price (SP) × (1 - Loss%)

**Calculation:**

Shobha's selling price to Lakshita ⇒ Rs. 6,00,000 × (1 + 20/100)

Shobha's selling price to Lakshita ⇒ Rs. 6,00,000 × (1.20)

Shobha's selling price to Lakshita ⇒ Rs. 7,20,000

Lakshita's selling price to Dinesh ⇒ Rs. 7,20,000 × (1 - 10/100)

Lakshita's selling price to Dinesh ⇒ Rs. 7,20,000 × (0.90)

Lakshita's selling price to Dinesh ⇒ Rs. 6,48,000

**Dinesh paid Rs. 6,48,000 for the plot.**

questions.question: A sum of money deposited at simple interest amounts to Rs. 1,020 in three years and Rs. 980 in two years. The sum deposited is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 3 years = Rs. 1,020.

Amount after 2 years = Rs. 980.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = Amount - Principal

Interest for 1 year = Simple Interest / Time

**Calculation:**

Interest for the third year = Rs. 1,020 - Rs. 980 = Rs. 40

⇒ Principal + 2 × (Interest for 1 year) = Rs. 980

⇒ Principal + 2 × Rs. 40 = Rs. 980

⇒ Principal = Rs. 980 - Rs. 80

⇒ Principal = Rs. 900

**The sum deposited is Rs. 900.**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 36 days, while B can do it in 48 days. B worked on it for 12 days and leaves it. How many days will A take to finish the remaining work?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Work done by B in 12 days = 12 ÷ 48 = 1/4 part

Remaining work = 1 − 1/4 = 3/4 part

Time taken by A to complete 3/4 work = 3/4 × 36 = 27 days

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**
